| 81–98 | 3 or 4 |
| 99 | 2 |
| 100–102 | 3 |
| 103–106 | 2 or 3 |
| 107–118 | 2 (or 3 at 110, 105, 106) |

Therefore Mary's score was $\boxed{119}$.
